tool.help:
.. class:: infomark
**What it does**
Generates and edits images with the FLUX models by Black Forest Labs: from a text prompt, by editing or combining reference images, or by redrawing a masked part of an image.
**Tasks and models**
================================= ========================================= Task Models ================================= ========================================= Generate an image from the prompt FLUX.2 [klein] 4B, FLUX 3 Image Klein Edit or combine reference images FLUX.2 [klein] 4B, FLUX 3 Image Klein (up to 10 images) Inpainting FLUX.2 [klein] 4B ================================= =========================================
FLUX.2 [klein] 4B is licensed under Apache 2.0. FLUX 3 Image Klein (FLUX Kommunity License) may not be used commercially. Which models are offered depends on what the administrator installed.
**Input**
1. **Task** and **Model**, with the images the task needs. Images are PNG or JPG. 2. **Prompt**: a txt file, or text typed in the form. For editing it describes the change. 3. **Advanced options**: image size (default 1024x1024, or the size of the input image), inference steps and guidance scale (default: the model's recommended values), seed, and whether FLUX 3 Image Klein expands the prompt first.
**Output**
A PNG image.
